activity_summary: You looked back along the path you had just walked. The hedge was on one side and the thin wheat on the other. No one was in the frame, and you did not add a word.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked back once, and did not speak.

entities.name: the long hedge
entities.context: Mentioned in The path back through the stubble

facets.activity: Looked back at the hedge and the thin wheat
